description.text: This program is designed for students who are keen to learn Chinese language .The courses within this program focus on language skills of listening ,Speaking .Reading and Wriing .Students are able to make basic conversations through first years' study,will have a comprehensive understanding of Chinese Language and be able to enter into the Bachelor Degree programs after completion of 2 years' study. Course Feature (1)Small-sized teaching mode and equal opportunity to interact with the lecturers (2)Placement test can recommend the most appropriate levels to students (3)One-to-one learning system between Chinese students and internatinal students enable them to practice Chinese language and understand more about the Chinese culture easily. We arrange field trips to historical site every semester and organize sightseeing activities and cultural visits in Zhejiang aperiodically

duration.text: The Chinese Language at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per semester ￥ 8000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
